notes_dir.label: Notes directory
notes_dir.description: Folder holding your Markdown notes; use the browse button to pick one.

search_limit.label: Search result limit
search_limit.description: Maximum number of app search results (3-20).

recent_count.label: Recent files shown
recent_count.description: How many recent files the card lists (3-15).

motion.label: Card motion
motion.description: Light = instant (recommended); Soft = 220 ms reveal; Off = cards stay still, the panel is unchanged.

hotspot_ssid.label: Hotspot name (SSID)
hotspot_ssid.description: Empty = reuse the name rice-hotspot remembers (<hostname>-hotspot by default).

hotspot_password.label: Hotspot password
hotspot_password.description: At least 8 characters; empty = use the generated password (see: rice-hotspot password).

hotspot_band.label: Hotspot band
hotspot_band.description: 2.4GHz is most compatible; 5GHz is faster but older devices may not see it.
